name: snipara-execution
description: Safe Python execution for OpenClaw coding agents via Snipara RLM-Runtime
author: Snipara

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Execute Python code in a sandboxed environment. Safe for math, data processing, and algorithm work. Use 'result = <value>' to return a value. Use print() for output.

sessionId.description: Session ID for isolated context. Variables persist across calls with same session ID.

profile.description: Execution profile: quick (5s), default (30s), analysis (120s), extended (300s)

tools.name: agent_run
tools.description: Start an autonomous agent that iteratively solves a task. The agent loops: observe → think → act → terminate. Returns a run_id to check status.

task.description: The task for the agent to solve

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Check the status of an autonomous agent run. Returns running/completed/error status and the result if done.

runId.description: The agent run ID from agent_run
The agent run ID to cancel
